title: Sum of Absolute Differences in a Sorted Array
summary: Given a sorted integer array, create and return an array where each element is the sum of absolute differences between that element and all other elements in the original array.
statement: Given a sorted integer array, create and return an array where each element is the sum of absolute differences between that element and all other elements in the original array.
constraints: nums is sorted nondecreasing and nonempty.
At each index return the sum of absolute differences from that value to every array entry.
hints: Sorted order removes absolute-value ambiguity on each side of an index.
Use prefix sum for smaller values and total-minus-prefix for larger values.
Left contribution is value*i-left_sum; right is right_sum-value*(n-i-1).
Every earlier value contributes value-other and every later value contributes other-value, so the two formulas partition the full sum.
editorial: Every earlier value contributes value-other and every later value contributes other-value, so the two formulas partition the full sum.

tests.explanation: For values two, three, and five the sums are four, three, and five.
